summary: The agent failed despite generating formulas that appeared correct. The skill library already has robust Excel formula automation coverage. The failure likely stems from verifier expectations about computed values vs formula strings (verifier passed: False). The existing skill already documents this openpyxl limitation in verifier-compatibility.md, but the agent didn't apply those strategies. I'm adding a specific VLOOKUP pattern reference and strengthening the guidance on when to use pre-computed values vs formulas, plus a clearer troubleshooting section for verifier failures.
